Aria: Dropping Aster LoRA merge into staging with quick-eval. Need: int4 vs int8 smoke, tokenizer remap check, and 30 prompt behavioral scan.
Sam: Command?
Aria: `./ci/gen_eval.sh --base aster/base --lora merges/aster-lora.safetensors --out /tmp/aster --quant int4 --map aster-remap.json --seed 7`
Ravi: Kickoff on dev GPU. Note: remap.json maps 3 custom tokens -> new IDs. Could cause top1 shifts.
Sam: Please run token alignment diff first (`scripts/token_align.sh base tok_remap`)
Ravi: Token diff quick output: top1 mismatch 6.2% across sampleset; 3 tokens account for most shifts.
QA Bot: Smoke rules: ppl_delta <= +0.8, hall_rate <= 5%. Int4 run -> ppl +0.9, hall_rate 6.7%, token_shift_count 11. Status: FAIL-WARN.
Aria: OK. Will try int8 and a patched remap that pins 2 hot tokens back to original IDs.
Infra Bot: CI job #4973 started: branch=feature/aster-lora commit=9b2d3a
QA Bot: Int8 results -> ppl +0.25, hall_rate 2.0%, token_shift_count 1, latency +9%. Status: PASS
Sam: Recommend documenting tradeoff (int8 cost vs int4 savings) and propose canary: 3% traffic, 30m window, rollback on hall_rate >4%.
Aria: Will draft note for customer onboarding folder with seeds, evalpack id, remap diff and suggested canary. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
